title: intent: flatten interview into discovery
description: Collapse src/intent/interview hierarchy into discovery.rs. Remove redundant nesting and one-struct-per-file patterns.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain a flat module structure for intent logic.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide it via src/intent/discovery.rs.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass architectural linting

invariants: No change in external discovery API behavior

title: intent: flatten plan into planning
description: Collapse src/intent/plan into planning.rs. Consolidate Resolver and Bead generation logic.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL consolidate planning logic into a single module.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL use the src/intent/planning.rs module.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow it to remain distributed

postconditions: planning.rs is the single source of planning logic

title: intent: flatten quality module
description: Delete ad-hoc quality scoring logic in intent and flatten remaining context handlers into quality.rs.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL delegate quality math to the lattice module.

unwanted.condition: IF intent attempts to re-calculate score math
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT permit ad-hoc logic

postconditions: Intent quality logic is a thin wrapper
invariants: No scoring math exists in the intent module

phase_1: Update handlers to use domain traits

title: intent: unify storage with src/storage
description: Redirect intent persistence to use the centralized redb storage layer. Remove intent-specific storage logic.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL use a single storage engine for all persistence.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL use src/storage handlers.

unwanted.condition: IF intent data is stored in isolated files
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow disparate storage patterns

preconditions: src/storage supports project metadata and answers
postconditions: Intent module has no direct file I/O
invariants: Storage integrity is maintained across migrations

phase_0: Identify all I/O points in intent
phase_1: Swap file calls for redb calls

title: intent: implement typestate sessions
description: Define DiscoverySession and ValidatedSession types to enforce phase gating at the type level.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL represent workflow phases as distinct types.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return a new session type.

unwanted.condition: IF an unvalidated session is used for planning
